backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing access control, user profiles, approval workflow, and chat request creation with permission checks. Stores users and chat requests using Maps with admin and approval validation on all actions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requirements to affected frontend files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of summarized frontend files describing each module’s purpose, key behaviors, and implementation details for navigation, Firebase usage, UI, and chat logic.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook outlining build steps, approval gating checks, troubleshooting, and rollback procedures for Firebase-hosted production releases.
frontend/firestore.rules: Firestore security rules defining authentication, admin roles, approval requirements, and permissions for users, profiles, chat requests, and chats.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes, applying base styles to borders and the body.
frontend/index.html: Sets up the HTML entry point and initializes Firebase services before loading the React app.
frontend/LIVE_SMOKE_TEST.md: Post-deployment smoke test checklist verifying admin creation, role migration, dashboard access, and approval flows.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Implements client-side route handling via React state and renders screens with a React Query provider.
frontend/src/components/admin/PendingUse: Renders a dialog showing detailed information about a pending user, including profile, contact, and personal data.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserRowAct: Provides a dropdown of admin actions for a user row, including approve, reject, block, promote, and delete with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: Protects admin-only routes by verifying the user's role and invokes a callback on unauthorized access.
frontend/src/components/auth/Authenticat: Checks Firebase auth and profile approval status, restricting access for unauthenticated or unapproved users except admins.
Defines a layout wrapper for authentication screens with centered content and a footer.
frontend/src/components/auth/SuperAdminR: Restricts access to super-admin-only routes by checking the user's role and running an unauthorized callback.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatRoomVie: React chat view that fetches messages, auto‑scrolls, formats timestamps, and sends new messages via Firebase. Uses React Query for polling and mutation updates.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: App header showing logo and user info, pulling profile data from Firebase Auth and Firestore. Renders a profile menu when the user is loaded.
frontend/src/components/layout/ProfileMe: User dropdown menu showing profile info with navigation options and logout handling. Supports admin-specific navigation and clears cached queries on logout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an Internet Identity–authenticated backend actor, reinitializing when identity changes. Invalidates dependent queries when actor updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirebaseAuthUser.t: Loads Firebase Auth dynamically from CDN and manages auth state subscription. Exposes the authenticated user and loading status.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestorePendingUs: Fetches pending users and provides actions to approve, reject, block, or promote them. Automatically invalidates related queries after mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUserProfi: Fetches the Firestore user profile for the authenticated user with no caching. Enabled only when Firebase Auth is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUsersList: Loads all users and provides mutations for approving, rejecting, blocking, promoting, and deleting users with toast notifications. Refetches the user list after updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state and helpers using Dfinity AuthClient. Manages identity loading, login flow, error states, and context access.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and defines light/dark theme CSS variables and base styles.
frontend/src/lib/firebase.ts: Provides Firebase wrappers for CDN-loaded SDK, dynamic module loading, and auth/profile helpers.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseErrorMessages.t: Maps Firebase error codes to user-friendly messages.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for user profiles and signup data.
frontend/src/lib/postLoginRedirect.ts: Determines post-login redirect route based on approval status.
Resizes, compresses, and validates profile images client‑side.
frontend/src/lib/roles.ts: Normalizes and checks user roles, including admin and super-admin helpers.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility for merging Tailwind/clsx class names.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminChatsScr: Admin-protected placeholder screen for future chat management features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminDashboar: Admin dashboard that summarizes total, approved, pending, and admin user counts using Firestore data.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminLayout.t: Provides the admin layout with sidebar navigation and mobile sheet menu, wrapping page content based on current admin route.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminReportsS: Renders the admin reports page inside AdminLayout with placeholder content indicating reports are coming soon.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminSettings: Displays the admin settings page inside AdminLayout with placeholder UI for future configuration features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminUsersScr: Implements the admin user management interface with user lists, status badges, and actions like approve, reject, block, and promote.
frontend/src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx: Displays chat list and selected chat view by loading accepted chats and profiles.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Shows a welcome message, basic dashboard cards, and footer for logged-in users.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: Login form that authenticates with Firebase, loads the user profile, handles blocked/rejected/approval checks, and navigates based on status.
frontend/src/screens/PasswordResetScreen: Screen explaining that password resets require admin assistance and provides a simple acknowledgement flow.
frontend/src/screens/PendingApprovalScre: Displays pending-approval status with guidance on admin review timelines and a button to return to login.
frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx: Shows the authenticated user’s profile info, including avatar and role, using Firestore and Firebase Auth data.
frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx: User signup form with profile image capture/upload, validation, Firebase account creation, and profile creation logic.
frontend/src/screens/users/ApprovedUsers: Shows a list of approved users and manages chat request sending and responses using Firebase and React Query.
frontend/src/screens/users/UserManagemen: Provides a simple user management view for approving or rejecting users fetched from Firebase.
frontend/src/screens/UsersScreen.tsx: Loads the current user profile and displays a unified approved users list view.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage support for persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling dark mode, custom colors, animations, and plugins like typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing versioned state, constraints, known issues, and a list of existing feature requirements for the system.
